description: This file defines a MonoBehaviour class 'OutdoorTouch' for a Unity project, handling touch input to activate/deactivate specific game objects based on touched objects.

classes.name: OutdoorTouch
classes.description: A MonoBehaviour class handling touch interactions, activating and deactivating game objects based on user input.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes game objects and populates an array with 'arrow' game objects, setting their active state to false initially.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Checks for touch input, performs raycast to detect touched objects, and activates corresponding arrows based on the object touched. Also handles a reset case.
